messages:
mona_procurement: Quick update from vendor — APAC top‑up shipment slipped ~1 week due to customs backlog. They propose splitting the shipment: air for 8 H100s (priority), sea for rest. Thoughts? :ship: 

raj_sre: prefer air for node-critical units. Which racks are impacted?

mona_procurement: priority list from infra: rack-nyc-prod-3 (2), rack-sf-inference-1 (3), rack-sin-edge-2 (3). Total 8.

alec_ops: +1 to air split. Cost will spike but keeps SLAs. What's vendor pricing delta?

vendor-bob: air premium is +18% on unit price, plus brokerage ~USD 120/unit. We can consolidate AWBs to one air waybill for the 8 units to reduce brokerage by ~30%.

emma_logistics: consolidation OK if all serials verified preflight. Last wave had two serial mismatches on manifest — we need clean manifest to avoid customs hold.

mona_procurement: vendor — can you reissue manifest with serials and declared values? Put all 8 on single AWB and mark as 'urgent replacement' to nudge customs.

vendor-bob: will reissue manifest in 30m. Note: two units flagged DOA at vendor inspection; they offered partial replace + RMA transits.

raj_sre: DOA units — are they from the 8 priority units or the sea batch? If priority, we need immediate loaners.

vendor-bob: DOAs are 2 units from the priority pool. We can either (a) include two refurbished loaners in the air split (no extra cost, ETA same), or (b) expedite factory replacements (2–3 week lead).

alec_ops: option (a) is acceptable short term. We need serial traceability and a formal RMA record for the refurb loaners.

rma-bot: New RMA created: RMA-4579. Items: H100 x2 (refurb loaners), reason: DOA vendor test. ETA inbound: same air AWB. Linked PO: PO-99321.

emma_logistics: received RMA-4579. I'll update customs paperwork once vendor sends consolidated AWB + corrected manifest. Please cc me on the AWB.

mona_procurement: vendor — confirm consolidated AWB number and upload manifest to shared drive. Also please mark insurance value at full replacement cost — customs flagged undervalued in prior shipments.

vendor-bob: AWB will be 123-45678901. Manifest uploading now. Insurance set at full replacement.

raj_sre: one more ask — route the 8 units via SIN hub, not to FRA. We have a temporary network edge constraint in EU region; migrating through SIN avoids regional rack constraints.

vendor-bob: SIN routing OK, adds ~6h transit.

alec_ops: final decision: proceed with air split for 8 units consolidated on AWB 123-45678901, include 2 refurb loaners for DOA, vendor to cover loaner warranty and serial swap. Mona, approve cost delta (air premium + consolidated brokerage) up to USD 18k?

mona_procurement: approve up to USD 18k. Please proceed. 

emma_logistics: I'll monitor customs lane and confirm ETA once AWB is live. :eyes:

rma-bot: RMA-4579 status updated: manifest attached, AWB 123-45678901, tracking initialized.

vendor-bob: thanks — shipping label and tracking attached in the drive. Will ping on customs hold if anything pops.

raj_sre: good call. Once units land, Alec/infra please coordinate swap windows during low traffic hours.

alec_ops: noted — will schedule maintenance windows for rack-nyc-prod-3 and rack-sf-inference-1.

mona_procurement: closing loop. Thanks everyone.
